truth: Hugging Face hosts the models. This page translates the tasks and docs. It does not download or train weights.

lanes.say: Enter a public model id on the bench. The weights stay on Hugging Face.
A plan only. You must own the data, keep a hidden test, and use an open license. This site does not train.
Twelve-style word checks for Buddy's written replies. This does not test a Hugging Face model.
Keep only weights you trained and have the right to keep.
